summary: A claim made in the address leads the other party to ask for a committee hearing.
realLife: After a president's address, one House member of the other party called a claim about benefit fraud false and asked for an immediate committee hearing. The story did not say if the hearing was set.
sources: WFSB (Hartford, Connecticut), 'Local reactions, debates ensue following President Trump's address to Congress', March 5, 2025: https://www.wfsb.com/2025/03/05/local-reactions-president-trumps-congressional-address-sparks-debate/
